bio.text: Peter Welch is a U.S. Senator from Vermont, elected in 2022 to succeed Patrick Leahy, and previously represented Vermont in the U.S. House after winning election in 2006.
He was first elected to the Vermont State Senate in 1980 and became its President Pro Tempore.

He was born in Springfield, Massachusetts, attended the College of the Holy Cross, received a law degree from the University of California, Berkeley, in 1973, and worked as a public defender in White River Junction, Vermont.
